subject: Re: Request to rebalance uptime anchor and monthly remedy - PivotalAI
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@pivotalai.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.ai
Cc: contracts@pivotalai.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:23:00 -0500
Subject: Uptime anchor + monthly remedy — ask from procurement

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement at PivotalAI has reviewed the standard SLA and we'd like to propose a small adjustment before final sign-off. Two asks from our side: 1) move the uptime anchor from 99.9% to 99.85% for the first 6 months of the pilot while we do a regional failover validation, and 2) cap monthly service credits at a fixed EUR amount rather than a percent of monthly spend for the pilot period.

We appreciate Redwood's baseline guarantees but need these accommodations written into the SOW to get internal approval. Attached is our redline doc (PivotalAI_SLA_Redlines_20261201.docx) highlighting the changes. Can you let me know what's feasible?

Elena
Elena Rossi
Head of Procurement, PivotalAI
elena@pivotalai.com

Attachment: PivotalAI_SLA_Redlines_20261201.docx (docx)
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@pivotalai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, contracts@pivotalai.com
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Uptime anchor + monthly remedy — ask from procurement

Hi Elena — thanks for the redlines and the clear ask. We reviewed this with product and legal. High level response: we can support a temporary reduction in the uptime anchor for the defined pilot window, provided we add a short-term operational playbook (regional failover test plan, P0 contact cadence) and a mutual exit clause at the end of the pilot.

On the credit cap: rather than an open fixed EUR cap (which exposes us to large variance), we'd propose a conservative fixed cap for the pilot that aligns to expected pilot spend. Suggested compromise: cap credits at EUR 12,500 / month for the 3-month pilot phase, with an option to revisit on renewal. If procurement prefers a % cap instead we can offer 10% of monthly committed spend as an alternative.

I've attached our proposed SLA amendment (RI_SLA_Proposal_20261204.pdf) with inline language for the uptime anchor temporary window and the credit cap. Marissa, Ben — looping you for ops/legal/CS input on the playbook and the suggested EUR cap.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai
Office: +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: RI_SLA_Proposal_20261204.pdf (pdf)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Elena Rossi <elena@pivotalai.com>, contracts@pivotalai.com
Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2026 09:41:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Uptime anchor + monthly remedy — ask from procurement

Irene / team — quick operational notes from CS/Reliability:

- We can accept a 99.85% anchor for the first 6 weeks of the pilot (not 6 months) as a narrower, time-boxed concession. After the 6-week validation, we require a signed confirmation that the regional failover tests completed and metrics meet the agreed thresholds before restoring 99.9%.
- The playbook needs 3 concrete acceptance checks: successful failover under load, KV-cache warmup time < 12s for cold-starts, and observed p95 generation latency below 450ms for our batched profile.
- EUR 12.5k/month cap is acceptable for the narrow pilot window. For the longer 6-month ask, that cap is risky unless we change throttling/burst policies.

Ben — legal cue: if procurement accepts 6 weeks + acceptance gates, are we comfortable feeding that into the amendment language and keeping the credit cap as suggested?

Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@pivotalai.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, contracts@pivotalai.com
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Uptime anchor + monthly remedy — ask from procurement

Elena — thanks for the patience and for outlining the variance. Quick legal/contract position: we can commit to the following path if PivotalAI agrees:

1) Pilot window: 6 weeks at 99.85% uptime anchor.
2) Operational acceptance gates as Marissa listed must be completed within the 6-week window.
3) Monthly credit cap during the pilot: EUR 12,500.
4) After acceptance, the SLA anchor reverts to 99.9% and standard remedy schedule applies.
5) Mutual termination clause for the pilot with 30-day notice and no penalty.

If that aligns, we'll produce an amendment draft and a short mutual test-plan attachment that both sides sign. I've attached a redline-friendly snippet we can drop into the master SOW.

Next steps: Elena — can you confirm that procurement is OK with 6 weeks (rather than 6 months) and the EUR 12.5k cap? If yes, I'll circulate the amendment for signature and propose a Docusign for the mutual test-plan.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced: PivotalAI_SLA_Redlines_20261201.docx (from Elena), RI_SLA_Proposal_20261204.pdf (from Irene).
